violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. - OBSERVED: a food employee on cook line wiped their gloved hands on their apron before handling roasted chicken.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and food employee. The food employee washed their hands properly.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: - OBSERVED: the cook line hand sink was used to store a sharpening stone and a piece of wet cloth.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM removed the sharpening stone and wet cloth.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - OBSERVED: hot water temperature at the cook line hand sink was 81f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the hand sink within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: (1) cooked yuca and cooked onion on cook line, (2) cooked corn on service line.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM. CFM labeled the food items with 4 hour end point.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: - OBSERVED: a disclosure is missing for under cooked food items.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM added a disclosure to the menu.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. - OBSERVED: Residential rodent repellent was stored in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM will remove the rodent repellent. EDY'S CHICKEN AND STEAK (Inspection Date: 07/27/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: - OBSERVED: several squeeze bottles of salad dressing were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and prompted CFM to label the squeeze bottles properly. EDY'S CHICKEN AND STEAK (Inspection Date: 07/27/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. - OBSERVED: a live cockroach was observed at the cook line hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent pest control service within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: a stack of disposable salad bowls were stored in cut lettuce in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM removed the salad cups.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: a spray nozzle was attached downstream from a mop sink equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS shared information of approved splitter with CFM. CFM will need to install an approved splitter on the mop sink.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the COOK LINE HAND SINK piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CDI: CUT LETTUCE CUPS WERE COVERED WITH A LID.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED YUKA UNDER A HEAT LAMP AT 128-136F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: COOKED YUKA RAISED HIGHER TO PROPERLY HOLD AT 135F OR ABOVE. PLEASE MONITOR REGULARLY.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. MANAGER’S CFM CERTIFICATE EXPIRED 7/10/2025.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM MUST BE PRESENT AT THE RESTAURANT DURING ALL TIMES OF OPERATION. PLEASE RENEW THIS CERTIFICATE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED FRENCH FRIES HOLDING AT 122.8F UNDER A HEAT LAMP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: A METAL CONTAINER WAS PLACED UNDER THE FRY TRAY AND FRIES WERE LIFTED CLOSER TO THE HEAT LAMPS IN ORDER FOR THEM TO REMAIN ABOVE 135F. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN KITCHEN: RAW CHICKEN AT 51F, OBSERVED IN THREE-DOOR PREP TOP: CUT TOMATO AT 61.5F AND 63.4F (1HR, COOLER WAS AT 63F), OBSERVED IN RESIDENTIAL COUNTERTOP COOLER: SPROUTS AT 48F, HALF & HALF AT 45.4F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: WORKER STARTED COOKING RAW CHICKEN. ALL TCS FOODS IN THREE-DOOR PREP TOP MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER. ALL TCS FOODS IN RESIDENTIAL COOLER DISPOSED OF.
